summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the repo (not committed, tests not run). Changes: rich/progress.py adds TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time (defaulted field before visible), finished derived from finished_time, clearing in _reset and Progress.reset, and capture in update and advance inside the lock. rich/default_styles.py adds progress.elapsed (yellow). rich/palette.py adds Palette.__rich__ with method-local imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added entry. Tests: tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast), test_time_elapsed_column added in tests/test_progress.py, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns with its expected output regenerated by hand-tracing clock reads (bars 33→25 start frames, 23→16 finished frames, elapsed values 37/36 then 60/45, speed 2→1 byte/s for the second task). Verified bar lengths by regex only. Unverified: test_columns and the other tests were not executed; test_track, test_progress_track, and test_render were checked by reading and should be unchanged.
